provenance: New source translation with E4790-E4799 and E4880-E4889 reviewed.
context: Tanya returns her bunny to its friends; party saves them from a monster. Fiore completes a delivery. Cyrus searches demon-ransacked chests for a scented wand. Tanya approaches a supposed revenge duel.
decisions: Bunny gender unknown. Tanya's remorse and gratitude preserved. Item count and currency retained. E4879 leads into the next owner's duel-trap scene; cross-row sentences retain breaks.

translations.en: Did I do something wrong just because I was selfish?
Bunny, you want to go back to your friends, don't you?
The Heart Bunnies gathered there
made no attempt to attack. They simply stared at @7rTanya@0r,
never looking away.
Bunny, you can go back to your friends.
I think both you and your friends must have been lonely.
I'm sorry.
Though @7rTanya@0r looked close to tears,
she seemed to have decided to return the pink bunny to its group.
Just as @7rTanya@0r was about to give a little wave goodbye,
a monster appeared behind the bunnies
and began attacking them!
Aaaaaah!
Please! You've got to save the bunnies!
Did the Heart Bunnies
understand that you had saved them?
As though offering their thanks, they hopped about
and danced around you and @7rTanya@0r for a while.
Ahaha! Thank you!
What a cute dance!
Eventually, the Heart Bunnies gathered together,
glancing back now and then as though reluctant to part,
and disappeared into the labyrinth's darkness.
They were all so cute.
But I was wrong to take Bunny away from the group
and turn Bunny into a stuffed toy.
I think I'll stop wanting stuffed toys
just because they're cute.
Thank you for saving Bunny.
Now, let's go back to town!
You saw a figure in the mist.
Straining your eyes, you saw someone stagger to their feet
and wave desperately.
It's the stranded adventurer!
Hellooo! @7rFiore@0r Express Delivery!
We've got a package for you!
After confirming the stranded adventurer's name, @7rFiore@0r
handed over the package and completed the delivery.
One person rescued!
Well, shall we head back to town? Come on!
What about this box?
What'll we do if we never find it?
Demon
I'll kill you before you can search it,
so there's no need to worry about its contents.
What?! N-no... Demons...
When had they crept so close?
Numerous demons stood with weapons drawn,
surrounding your party.
That's the last box.
Once we've killed you, we'll take our time destroying it!
What on earth is inside this box?
You opened the box to examine its contents.
Inside was a short wand giving off
a faint scent like fragrant wood.
Would such a faint scent really bother demons?
Damn it, this is beyond what I know.
Let's hurry back to the tavern and have @7rBeatrix@0r appraise it.
If she can't, we can ask @7rAnselm@0r.
Anyway, let's hurry back!
As you reached for the treasure chest,
a piercing cry suddenly rang out!
You opened the treasure chest.
But it was empty.
There was a treasure chest with its lid already open.
Strangely, although it had been ransacked, its items
showed no sign of having been taken.
You obtained three @3rElixirs@0r and @3r300 G@0r.
You obtained @3r300 G@0r.
Demons have been ransacking them.
They tear the boxes apart but don't take the contents.
Doesn't that prove they're looking for the same thing we are?
The legend was true.
Come on! We have to find it before the demons do!
I think it's around here... but I'm not sure.
Just as @7rTanya@0r muttered those unenthusiastic words,
you spotted what seemed to be the people ahead.
That's them. There... Huh?
But something's strange.
